FHESS POST 6 — THE RESEARCHER ENTERS THE FIELD
ZORGVERANTWOORDING OF THE INTERVENTION ITSELF
 
FHESS POST 5 examined the interval between successive configurations within the fiels of war.
With Communication VI to the Office of the Prosecutor, FHESS moved from finding a possible institutional capacity to responsibly addressing that capacity.
 
A researcher studies a field.
The researcher may also discover that an existing institutional capacity can responsibly be addressed.
When that finding leads to an intervention, something changes.
The intervention itself enters the field.
 
On 1 September 2026, FHESS Communication VI — INTERIM ZORGVERANTWOORDING — UKRAINE was submitted to the Office of the Prosecutor of the International Criminal Court. The submission was received and assigned its own Submission ID.
 
Communication VI expressly submits its own intervention to ZORGVERANTWOORDING. It makes its preparatory FHESS research readable and relates the proposed interim actualisation to existing capacities under Articles 54, 56 and 57 of the Rome Statute.
 
AN INTERVENTION DOES NOT ONLY ACT UPON A FIELD.
IT ENTERS THE FIELD AS A NEW FACTUALITY. 
 
Before the intervention:
  
C₁ — a configuration is being read
Then:

KNOWLEDGE POSITION ↓
POSSIBLE CAPACITY BECOMES READABLE ↓
RESPONSIBLE INTERVENTION ↓
ZORGVERANTWOORDING
 
After the intervention:

C₂ — the intervention itself has become part of the configuration
 
The movement can therefore continue:
 
NEW FACTUALITY ↓
NEW KNOWLEDGE POSITION ↓
NEW READABILITY ↓
POSSIBLE FURTHER ACTUALISATION
 
This also develops the interval examined in POST 5.
 
Between C₁ and C₂ we can ask:
 
Δt — what changed through time?
Δs — which step entered the configuration?
Δv — which potentially relevant value became available through that step?
 
Communication VI does not determine its own Δv.
 
Its possible contribution becomes readable only through what subsequently happens within the field: reception, examination, differentiation, correction, further investigation, or another responsible institutional response.
 
This is why ZORGVERANTWOORDING also applies to research itself.
 
The researcher can make readable:
 
FROM WHICH POSITION DID I ACT?
WHICH KNOWLEDGE POSITION WAS AVAILABLE?
WHICH CAPACITY DID I ADDRESS?
WHAT DID MY INTERVENTION ADD TO THE CONFIGURATION?
WHAT REMAINS OPEN AFTER I ACTED?
 
FHESS therefore does more than follow configurations before action.
 
FHESS CAN FOLLOW ITS OWN INTERVENTIONS AFTER THEY ENTER THE FIELD.
FIND → ACTUALISE → ACCOUNT → RE-READ
 
The research process becomes recursively readable.
 
RESPONSIBLE INTERVENTION CAN BECOME A NEW FACTUALITY WITHIN THE FIELD IT
SEEKS TO MAKE READABLE.
CARE CAN BE ACCOUNTED FOR.
THE FIELD REMAINS OPEN.
GRACES HAPPEN.

🤔 إيه الحكاية بالظبط؟
شركة K-tronik بتدور على Operational QA Manager قوي ومتحمس ينضم لفريقها في ميونخ. لو إنت شغوف بالتكنولوجيا وعندك خبرة في ضمان جودة البرمجيات خصوصًا في تطوير التطبيقات، ومستعد تشتغل في بيئة ديناميكية، الفرصة دي معمولالك!

💼 هتعمل إيه لو اتقبلت؟
*   **هتخطط وتراقب الجودة:** هتبقى مسؤول عن تخطيط ومراقبة جودة البرمجيات بشكل يومي مع فرق Scrum، وهتساعد في تحسين الـ Backlog وخطط الـ Sprint.
*   **هتدير الاختبارات والإصدارات:** هتشرف على كل مراحل الاختبارات (من Unit Tests لحد Acceptance Tests)، وهتعمل خطط اختبار، وتتابع الإصدارات بشكل يومي.
*   **هتكون نقطة وصل أساسية:** هتنسق بين فرق التطوير الداخلية، والشركاء الخارجيين، وحتى فرق الـ QA في سنغافورة والهند.
*   **هتتابع العمليات وتدير الأخطاء:** هتتأكد إن الشغل ماشي صح ومعايير الجودة متطبقة، وهتدير دورة حياة تتبع الأخطاء عشان تتأكد إن الأولويات مظبوطة.
*   **هتعمل مراجعات وتقارير:** هتراجع الأمور الفنية وهتعمل تقارير عن حالة الجودة باستمرار.

✨ باختصار، لو إنت قائد حقيقي في مجال ضمان الجودة وعندك عين حادة للتفاصيل، وقادر تنسق بين فرق مختلفة وفي بلاد مختلفة، فالمكان ده مستنيك. شركة K-tronik بتقدم بيئة عمل تشجع على الشغف والتطور في مشاريع تكنولوجية مستقبلية.

APT addresses Brazil’s Supreme Federal Court on the need to preserve in-person custody hearings

We participated in a public hearing before Brazil’s Supreme Federal Court to address the constitutionality of the provision of the recently enacted Anti-Organised Crime Law that makes videoconferencing the default format for custody hearings. 

In our intervention, we argued that in-person hearings in the first hours of detention are not simply a matter of procedural design. They are an essential safeguard for preventing torture and ill-treatment and ensuring effective judicial oversight following an arrest. International human rights bodies have repeatedly recognised the importance of physical presence in this context. 

Our own research also shows why this matters in practice. In observations of more than 110 virtual detention control hearings, we documented significant limitations in the ability to observe signs of violence and ensure privacy. Recent data, soon to be published in our Observa Custodia dashboard, shows that in 61% of the courts mapped, people participating in virtual hearings were connecting from a prison or police station rather than a judicial setting. 

Making virtual hearings the rule therefore risks weakening an important safeguard against torture and ill-treatment and constitutes a setback in the protection of human rights 

APT will continue to advocate for custody hearings that provide effective, independent and meaningful judicial oversight from the very first hours of detention.

خدعوك فقالوا: Activity Hijacking ثغرة! 🚨

هو أنا الوحيد اللي شايف إن موضوع Android Activity Hijacking ساعات بيتقدم كأنه ثغرة خطيرة من غير ما حد يسأل السؤال الأهم: الـ Impact إيه؟

يعني لو عندي Activity معمولة exported، وقدرت من App تاني أعمل Intent وأفتحها… تمام، أنا قدرت أوصل لـ Activity معينة.
وبعدين؟ 🤔

الموبايل موبايلي، والـ App عندي أصلاً، وأنا كمستخدم أقدر أفتح الـ Activity دي من التطبيق نفسه.
طيب المهاجم استفاد إيه لما يبعتلي malicious app، والتطبيق ده يدخلني على Activity معينة؟

هل مجرد إن App تاني قدر ينادي Activity = Vulnerability؟

ولا لازم يكون فيه security impact حقيقي زي:

تجاوز Authentication / Authorization
الوصول لبيانات مش المفروض أوصلها
تنفيذ Action بصلاحيات مش بتاعتي
تغيير State حساس في التطبيق
أو أي تأثير أمني واضح

لأن لو الـ Impact هو:
"المهاجم يقدر يفتح Activity معينة"
فأنا مش شايف فين المشكلة لوحدها.

خدعوك فقالوا: Attack Surface = Vulnerability.

إن الحاجة موجودة على الـ Attack Surface مش معناها تلقائياً إنها ثغرة.

🟥 A PUBLIC SHOUT-OUT TO THE INTERNATIONAL ACCOUNTABILITY COMMUNITY

5 September 2026
OPS Ref: UKSUPP/0725

To the International Anti-Corruption Academy, the European Center for Whistleblower Rights, the Southeast Europe Coalition on Whistleblower Protection, and every organisation working in whistleblower protection, public-interest investigation, transparency, victim support and institutional accountability:

I am asking you to look.

A reported hit-and-run on 14 July 2019 has developed into an eight-year, cross-institutional accountability case involving conflicting official records, evidence handling, disclosure failures, unanswered questions and continuing proceedings.

I am not asking anybody to accept my account without scrutiny.

I am asking for independent eyes to examine the documentary record.

For years, I have had to locate the records, reconstruct the chronology, identify the decision-makers and connect information held across police, healthcare, insurance, legal, court, tribunal, regulatory and government systems.

I am still doing that work alone while living with PTSD, post-traumatic brain-injury symptoms, ADHD and the continuing consequences of what happened.

The public record can be found by searching:

OPSRefUKSUPP0725 Mark Paul Jones

I can provide a concise press release, a one-page evidence summary and a controlled selection of core documents.

If your organisation investigates whistleblower disclosures, supports people exposing institutional failures, protects evidence or connects individuals with journalists, lawyers and public-interest advocates, I would welcome an independent conversation.

The request is simple:

LOOK AT THE RECORD.

TEST THE EVIDENCE.

ASK WHY THE MATERIAL QUESTIONS REMAIN UNANSWERED.

No allegation is made against any organisation named in this post. This is an open request for scrutiny, assistance and responsible engagement.

SHE LEFT THE REFUGE.

NREC's #WalkWithHarshita campaign continues with the documented chronology of Harshita Brella's contacts with Northamptonshire Police.

On 20 September 2024, the chronology records indirect contact with police through the refuge.

Harshita had left the refuge voluntarily and moved to a new address.
The refuge informed Northamptonshire Police, and her new address was recorded.

This entry follows the events of 19 September, when police had carried out a welfare check at the refuge and Harshita had said that she wanted to withdraw her complaint.

Why does following these individual entries matter?

Because the experience of domestic abuse — and someone's journey through safeguarding and criminal justice systems — cannot always be understood from one incident or one decision.

By placing each documented contact alongside the next, we can begin to understand the wider chronology and the interactions between Harshita and the agencies around her.

We will continue to distinguish between what the documented record tells us and what it does not.

No assumptions. No rewriting her experience.

We follow the facts. One date at a time.
